# All Pro Plumbers

> All Pro Plumbers is a licensed and insured residential plumbing company offering 24/7 emergency service in Jefferson County, Arkansas and the surrounding area. The business is known for upfront pricing, fast emergency response, and a workmanship guarantee on every job.

## Contact
- Phone (24/7 emergency line): 501-555-1212
- Text: 501-555-1212
- Service area: Jefferson County, Arkansas and surrounding communities

## Services
- [Drain Cleaning](/services/drain-cleaning.html) — clearing slow and clogged drains
- [Water Heater Repair & Installation](/services/water-heater-repair-installation.html) — repair, replacement, and installation of tank and tankless water heaters
- [Leak Detection & Repair](/services/leak-detection-repair.html) — locating and repairing hidden leaks, including slab leaks
- [Pipe Repair & Repiping](/services/pipe-repair-repiping.html) — spot repairs and full or partial repiping
- [Sewer Line Services](/services/sewer-line-services.html) — camera inspection, cleaning, and repair of sewer lines
- [Fixture Installation](/services/fixture-installation.html) — installation of faucets, toilets, sinks, and garbage disposals
